WHERE FEEDBACK TRIAGE ACTUALLY STANDS ACROSS THE THREE SOURCES, so the next session does not redo it or assume it is finished. Written because the previous standing note claimed things were uncaptured that had in fact shipped, which is what happens when a to-do list about feedback lives outside the graph it is about.

⭐ THE HEADLINE IS HOW MUCH WAS ALREADY DONE. Of everything checked today, the large majority was already captured, already shipped, or already settled. FOUR new facts came out of roughly forty items examined. That ratio is the useful number: the log is now mostly a record of things reflow2 has answered.

DEV_STORYFLOW (6,152-line log, highest priority). The newest block holds 28 entries. TWO were new and are now recorded: `propose_heal` describing neither what it swept nor what it considered, and the contradiction detector never reading Decision status. Both were REPRODUCED on reflow2's own graph before recording. Everything else in that block maps to a fact already held — typed parameter names, satisfies flattening coverage, export publishing other seats' work, the directory-artifact crash, orphan_node on a prescribed state, the malformed digest, propagate_change on DOCUMENTS artifacts, the absent kit, the exact-id overwrite, the VERIFIES narrowing (fixed in #198), and the stale-server family. NOT ASSESSED: the ~3,500 lines dated before 2026-08-15, which earlier sessions triaged into the bl-* family; nobody re-checked them today.

ALEX (two files, and they are DIFFERENT — checksums 007e2868 vs 0318c290). The 2026-08-14 one was already captured as `art:alex-grok-feedback-2026-08-14`. The ~2026-08-07/08 one on binary 0.24.0 had NEVER been triaged and now is, as `fact:alex-grok-0240-feedback-triaged-2026-08-16` — his top-priority ask did not reproduce on 0.32.1, and five of his six asks are either shipped, settled, or now recorded. ⚠️ HIS SEVEN 'OPPORTUNITIES' WERE NOT UNCAPTURED, contrary to the standing note: five had shipped or been recorded, and the near-duplicate guard caught the remaining two as existing nodes when this session tried to create them. Both were SHARPENED instead — which is the guard doing exactly its job, twice in a row, correctly.

MUSIC_GRAPH (F1–F24). F23 and F24 are FIXED AND RELEASED in v0.32.0 and v0.32.1. F22 was new and is now recorded. F21 — which the reporter called 'the significant finding of the session' — is already held as `dec:idea-should-an-understated-status-be-detected`, open on the same question. Confirmed already covered: F1 and F2 (the import envelope, by BL-117/118/138), F6, F7 (which W11 records as closing itself), F11, F12, F16. ⚠️ NOT INDIVIDUALLY ASSESSED, and this is the honest gap in today's sweep: F3, F4, F5, F8, F9, F10, F13, F14, F15, F17, F18, F19, F20 — thirteen items. F5 is the one to look at first: the reporter marks it 'dangerous' and says Interface modelling silently manufactures phantom circular dependencies, and it recurred twice in their log.

TWO METHOD NOTES WORTH KEEPING. (1) Verification changed the answer again — Alex's number-one pain did not reproduce, and two of the four new findings needed a source read before they could be stated correctly rather than as filed. (2) The `expected_absence` drift kind shipped in #195 is why the feedback ARTIFACTS read clean while their files are absent: those files are deliberately not kept in the repo, and a session that 'helpfully' re-adds one would be undoing a settled call.
